release_status_reason: FEX-dependent cases cannot run: the backend adapter is not implemented, so nothing drives FEXCore. The two 4 KiB assumptions that previously blocked this -- the JIT code-buffer guard page and InterruptFaultPage -- are fixed in the owned fork and verified on a real 16 KiB host, see docs/fex-host-page-size-adaptation.md. Note the earlier 'aborts at startup' claim was withdrawn: the VA probe is only reachable from FEXInterpreter, which an embedder does not link. Host-verifiable cases pass. No 16 KiB device was attached; the attached device reports a 4 KiB kernel page.
